original_question: A basket contains 25 oranges among which 1 is bad, 20% are unripe, 2 are sour and the rest are good. How many oranges are good?
question_template: A basket contains {num_digit_1, 25} oranges among which {num_digit_2, 1} is bad, {num_digit_3, 20}% are unripe, {num_digit_4, 2} are sour and the rest are good. How many oranges are good?
question_solution: answer = num_digit_1 - num_digit_2 - num_digit_1 * num_digit_3 / 100 - num_digit_4
conditions: int(answer) == num_digit_1 - num_digit_2 - num_digit_1 * num_digit_3 / 100 - num_digit_4
